usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is empty; only identity anchors and known confusables are present. A reader learns only the minimum identifying facts (name, birth date/place, WHO Chief Scientist and ICMR DG roles) with no substantive account of what she actually did. There are no claims to assess for overclaims, but the empty dossier cannot warn the reader about its own gaps, so remainingQuestions fails despite the useful confusableWith warnings (chess grandmaster, OpenAlex affiliation merge). With no content, no meeting preparation is possible beyond the identity anchors.
